description: Java source code for the CollateralManagementApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for collateral management operations such as create, retrieve, update, delete, and list collateral products.

classes.name: CollateralManagementApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for collateral management operations, handling HTTP requests related to collateral creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and listing.

methods.name: createCollateral
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new collateral, serializing the request and logging the command.

methods.name: getCollateral
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a specific collateral by ID, with permission validation.

methods.name: getAllCollaterals
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch all collateral products, with permission validation.

methods.name: getCollateralTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve collateral template data, specifically available currencies.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing collateral by ID, serializing the update request.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a collateral by ID.
